title: Bread and Almond Wine Stew
description: A hearty stew made with bread, almonds, and wine, perfect for a cold winter night. This stew is a twist on traditional bread soups.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.notes: any type of bread works, but rustic bread is best

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.notes: you can use slivered or sliced almonds, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: Wine
ingredients.notes: dry white wine works best, such as chardonnay or sauvignon blanc

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: any type of onion works, but sweet onion is best

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: you can use more or less garlic to taste

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: you can use store-bought or homemade broth

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt or sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: freshly ground pepper is always best

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice fresh flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sliced almonds and toast for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the cubed bread and stir to combine with the almonds and onion mixture.
Pour in the wine and chicken broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the bread is fully saturated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Note: you can also make this stew in a slow cooker. Simply brown the onion and garlic in a pan, then transfer everything to the slow cooker and cook on low for 2-3 hours.
